risk_note: RV1 (agent stream/http/store; 规划 11-12 A1, D10-1287; change record docs/changes/20261112-Agent模型路径与缺口补全.md §2.9; BR-AI-19 细则「助手回复落库」, BR-AI-20, 23). The RunManager accumulates the reply's OutputGuard-filtered text and its cards (stream/run/manager.ts) and hands them to admission.settle; stream/pg/finalize.ts finalizeRun writes agent_messages.text / card_ids and agent_cards (earnings card without amounts) in the same transaction as the terminal state (stream/pg/reply.ts writeReply), not touching agent_sessions.last_active_at; a run finished by another request (crash) gets no reply text and no cards; cards no longer go through the trace and the in-process pending cards are gone (order card refs read committed agent_cards only; TraceRedoQueue.pendingCard kept as a queue method, unused at runtime). Cards produced during the disconnect grace get their delivery receipts in the terminal transaction (stream/pg/deliveries.ts, same shape and lock as the normal receipt) so the next turn can reference them, while this turn's model still gets no reference ([AC-B3-05i#11]); card JSON is cleaned of NUL and lone surrogates before it is written (D10-1347 ④). The disconnected list's result chain is NOT backfilled (withdrawn per D10-1360 / D10-1361, redesign in B3-08zd ⑨): after a disconnected search turn, 'the N-th' follows the new list while 'another batch / other platform / other price' still continues the previous search. Session history: http/history.ts + stream/mount/history.ts createAgentHistoryRuntime listMessages — access through the same stream/access port (agent.enabled + whitelist), identity, consent, ownership (token → user_id only), 30504 for non-owner / missing, expired read-only, user text in its stored redacted form, earnings_summary_history projection; the GET route is not mounted while the contract marks it planned (content A9). Frozen tests (D10-1297): trace-retry/pending.test.ts and card-refs.int.test.ts deleted (in-process pending cards, 11 cases); eight [AC-B3-08q#5] / [AC-B3-08y#1/#5/#6/#8] cases changed only in their card assertions (modify_existing, six retitled); retirement table in test/spec/agent/reply-persist/kit.ts and the PR body. Reverse checks on the test machine / container slot: M1 (cards back through the trace) → 11 new cases and all 8 rewritten cases red; M2 (in-process pending read back) → 3 red, but only through the card-carrying trace half — the pure read-back path is not separable by any case (follow-up B3-08zd). Host: tsc / eslint / prettier / depcruise / guard static 0, agent unit tests, spec/agent non-integration 2954, all agent integration 96 files / 501 (before round 2), test-machine verify:fast green after round 2 (the full integration run exceeds the single-container 3600 s limit; full verification is the required CI checks, approvals #21). Follow-up B3-08zd: whitelist on GET history, same-transaction fault between reply write and terminal state, same-process rolled-back ending must not resolve its card_id.

D10-1314 must-checks (history through the same stream/access port incl. the whitelist; reply, cards and terminal state in one transaction) read in code. r1 S1 (disconnect-grace cards without delivery receipts) → fixed; r2 pass; orchestrator review of #3269 (D10-1347) → round 3 (chain backfill, card JSON cleaning, DB cases); r3 S1 and r4 S1 on the chain backfill (code rounds 3/3 used) → approvals 80 / D10-1360 one-off round 4 (shared append, own dedup removed) → r5 S1 again on the chain backfill (a no-result search after the list) → withdrawn per D10-1360 / D10-1361 (round-4 work kept as couli-runs/B3-08zc/backfill-chain-r4.patch for B3-08zd ⑨) → r6 on the withdrawal step only: pass (couli-runs/B3-08zc/review-codex-general-r1.json … -r6.json).
